Holy Priest Rotation in 

Healing typically has less of a strict rotation and more of a priority list. In both raid and mythic+, you will tailor your healing style by building up those respective Holy Words for the best effect. Holy tends to follow 3 key rules:

 

 
 Keep Holy Words on cooldown: Our Holy Words, Holy Word: Serenity and Holy Word: Sanctify , are our most powerful abilities and should be frequently used for maximum efficiency. If you know that predictable damage is incoming, especially single-target damage, you can pool Holy Words like Holy Word: Serenity to prepare to triage allies quickly, but you should not sit on 2 stacks of the Holy Words if you can help it. 

 

 

 
 Raid Healing with AoE or single-target: Holy has great balance across talents with competitive AoE and single-target builds at their disposal. Often, triage or "spot-healing" can be at a premium in progression raiding, as most Healer builds focus on even AoE healing. This capability offers an opportunity for Holy to provide crucial output to the most vulnerable allies. 

 

 

 
 Mythic+ Healing is flexible: The Ultimate Serenity talent lends a great deal of flexibility to Holy Priest in dungeons, allowing you to still cast Prayer of Healing to handle AoE healing while also giving you more Holy Word: Serenity s that also cleave your party members. 
 

Holy Priest Starter Guide

 Best Holy Priest Rotation

Below, we break down the main priority lists for Holy Priest: Raid and Mythic+ Priorities

 Best Holy Priest Raid Target Rotation

Holy is very flexible in Midnight with Prayer of Healing acting mainly as your mana burn to blast extra healing if you have the mana to afford it. Archon is the preferred playstyle and as Archon you will want to look to use Apotheosis and Halo together whenever possible and always look to have one Holy Word: Serenity and one Holy Word: Sanctify charge before you activate Apotheosis . With Oracle you will be pumping out greater Prayer of Mending casts and passive healing while Piety makes your healing more efficient. 

 Smite can be used as filler in downtime to play for Surge of Light procs for more cooldown reduction. 

 
Standard Apotheosis / Halo combo

 
Cast Holy Word: Serenity for single target healing on cooldown.

Consume any Surge of Light procs on Prayer of Healing whenever possible, you can hold up to two stacks.

Keep Prayer of Mending on cooldown.

Cast Flash Heal s to spot-heal as needed.

Cast Smite during downtime to farm for Surge of Light procs. 

Cast Divine Hymn for raid-wide damage.
 

 Mythic+ Healing

Holy Priest does a solid job at conserving its mana while producing excellent burst output with the Archon hero talent tree.

The major downside for Holy in Mythic+ is defensives and thats where high versatility can become very important for the high-end Holy Priest. Also it can be very productive to hold Holy Words from time to time to prepare for incoming boss mechanics. Holy has powerful and short cooldowns at its disposal in dungeons, making it imperative to frequently weave them into the mix to increase your damage, healing, or mana efficiency!

 Use the ✘ markers next to talent selections to populate the priority list.

Archon
Oracle

Priority

 
Cast Holy Word: Serenity on cooldown for single target.

Keep Prayer of Mending on cooldown. (Focus on refreshing/maintaining stacks on players).

Use Apotheosis frequently to save mana, reset the cooldowns of your Holy Words to prepare for additional burst damage or simply as a damage cooldown during downtime.

Use Flash Heal to build up stacks of Lightweaver to spend on more powerful Prayer of Healing casts. 
 

 Holy Priest Major Cooldown Usage

 Divine Hymn is your primary raid cooldown. Keep in mind that Divine Hymn can be cast while Line of Sight from your allies. This is particularly helpful when LoSing dangerous mobs like in a dungeon environment but has had some applications in prior raids like on the Jailer encounter. Hymn also does bonus healing in dungeons, making it a powerful healing cooldown in Mythic+!

 Apotheosis is an excellent cooldown that helps produce additional Holy Word casts. It reduces the cost of your Holy Word spells and allows you to cast Holy Words more rapidly. Regardless of the situation, your goal when using Apotheosis is to maximize your Holy Word casts during its duration, the best way to do so is to be ready to be casting spells like Prayer of Healing or Flash Heal to aggressively generate new Holy Words to spend. Pooling resources like Surge of Light procs or using talents like Divinity can help you generate new Holy Words more quickly and efficiently, resulting in some excellent sustained healing over its duration.

 Guardian Spirit is your main tank external and will function as a cheat death, putting the target back to 40% health if they intake lethal levels of damage. There is a limit to the damage that can be received but keep in mind that this talent is very valuable to use particularly on tanks that have solid self-healing capabilities like Blood DKs, communicating when and how you want to use these abilities and being mindful of how helpful/necessary it is to use it is also important. As Priest is often very weak on the defensive front, Guardian Spirit can be self-cast if necessary and if tanks are not utilizing the cooldown. 

 Desperate Prayer and Fade are your primary defensives. Protective Light allows you to receive 10% damage reduction at any point in an encounter just by casting Flash Heal on any ally thanks to the Binding Heals passive. With the Binding Heals talent it allows you to cast Flash Heal on any ally and this will always activate the Protective Light effect on yourself!

 Holy Priest Advanced Tips

 Archon gameplay is very straightforward as your Halo lasts longer, does increased healing, and increases the healing your allies receive for 10 seconds after your Halo heals them. As a result, you'll want to use Halo early as damage is hitting your raid, and when possible, pooling Holy Words to benefit from the increased healing. Not enough to cap on stacks or let a player sit low. Pairing your Halo with Apotheosis is an absolute must for the bonus healing that both spells receive when playing with Archon talents. This allows you to produce huge, sustained, and focused output for the duration.

The primary buff uptimes that you might play around is Apotheosis which grants faster cooldown reduction for your Holy Words and makes them cheaper to cast! You want every global cast during Apotheosis to be one that casts a Holy Word or reduces one .

 Oracle Priest will be using their additional charge of Prayer of Mending to produce better sustained and passive healing. With an extra charge also comes the abilities to pool Prayer of Mending casts which can be helpful if you know that you will need to move for an upcoming mechanic or if you need to provide some efficient spot-healing to an ally through the Prompt Prognosis talent.

 Piety is now passive in Midnight, redirecting any of your overheal to other allies in need. Unfolding Vision a new talent in Midnight, becomes especially helpful in a Mythic+ environment where it keeps your Prayer of Mending stacks active on allies instead of fully expiring, refreshing and maintaining these buffs by casting a Prayer of Mending on an ally who already has some stacks on them can also act as a way of reducing the "waste" of Prayer of Mending stacks and increasing your passive output in the process. Prayer of Mending can stack up to 14 and with our usual talents one cast will apply 7 stacks so as long as you are not overcapping past 14 with your cast, or if the duration is about to run off and the waste is less than or equal to 2 stacks, then you'll want to cast Prayer of Mending on that ally.

It maintains a WoW addon called the Wowhead Looter , which collects data as you play the game! 

 

It uploads the collected data to Wowhead in order to keep the database up-to-date! 

 

 
You can also use it to keep track of your completed quests, recipes, mounts, companion pets, and titles!
